rate_items.plan: Monthly outstanding balance, single life, with TPD benefit

rate_table_note: Annex A, 73.106(d): "If premiums are payable on a monthly outstanding balance basis, the monthly prima facie premium rate for credit life insurance on a single life shall be $.705 per $1,000 of outstanding balance, and shall be $.844 per $1,000 of outstanding balance for credit life insurance with TPD benefit on a single life." Single premium rates come from the formulas in 73.106(e) to (i) (not computed here); joint is 175% of single (73.106(j)). Dating: the order (Doc. No. 98-447, paragraph (d)) reads "The regulations adopted by this order shall take effect July 20, 1998"; the current Pennsylvania Code gives June 19, 1998 for sections 73.101 to 73.143 (the difference, possibly a correction at 28 Pa.B. 1941, was not resolved). The current text of 73.106(d) (read 2026-11-22) prints the same figures and no later amendment of 73.106; it is not saved here because the Code pages carry the Bureau's editorial notes, which 1 Pa. Code 3.44 lets be reproduced only with its consent. The Department reviews the rates at least every 3 years (73.106(l)); no adjustment notice was found for 2001 to 2026 (the Department's notice library lists none for 2020 to 2026). Date communicated left blank: the issue date is not printed in the saved pages (28 Pa.B. 1401 is Volume 28, Number 12). Also saved: archive/PA/2026-11-22_bdeaa1c5.html (PA-28PaB1401-order-98-447.html).
source_title: Insurance Department, Credit Insurance, final rulemaking, 31 Pa. Code ch. 73, Annex A (28 Pa.B. 1401; Doc. No. 98-447a)
summary: Rates in force: Pennsylvania's prima facie credit life rate on a monthly outstanding balance basis is $.705 per $1,000 ($.844 with total and permanent disability benefit), set in 31 Pa. Code 73.106(d) by the 1998 credit insurance rulemaking (effective 1998) and unchanged in the current Code. Credit A&H and IUI rates are published in separate notices and are not recorded.
